inference.contextSize: OpenAI-compatible requests omit context; require Ollama /api/ps context_length=4096 before extraction; cold-load probe requests num_ctx=4096 if model is absent

selectionPolicy.input: only the two exact source ranges identified in the frozen table arm
selectionPolicy.excluded: control-prefix text, gold, and QA questions are not passed to Hyper-Extract
selectionPolicy.zones: exact heading-delimited source slices; table row candidates use frozen rowText for mention anchors and retain full table packet/header text as the evidence zone

validationPolicy.nodes: literal candidate name substring in one zone anchorText; no normalization; node descriptions are never promoted and remain unvalidated candidate claims
validationPolicy.edges: all participants must be literal substrings of the same zone anchorText AND the complete candidate edge description must be a literal substring of that same zone relationText; otherwise HOLD; no co-occurrence inference

projectionPolicy.select: union of exact zones with at least one literal entity mention anchor or exact-quote relation candidate
projectionPolicy.content: verbatim source zone slices joined with a fixed blank-line delimiter; no model-generated fields enter the TEXT projection
projectionPolicy.nativeBoundary: candidate graph remains a sidecar; only the source-text projection enters unchanged GenesisRAG17 TEXT ingestion

executionAdapter.kind: ChatOpenAI subclass mapping upstream function_calling structured-output requests to json_schema
executionAdapter.actualRequestCapture: record path, model, max_tokens, max_completion_tokens, reasoning_effort, response_format type/name, and prompt-size counts for every call

runBoundary.input: Hyper-Extract receives only chunks from the frozen Paddle OCR text projection derived from the two PDFs; it does not parse PDF bytes or run OCR
runBoundary.output: candidate graph remains an unvalidated sidecar; exact source text projection is a separate native TEXT input
